about: Rigaud is a city in Vaudreuil-Soulanges, Quebec, on the Ottawa River at the Ontario boundary, west of Montréal—not a borough of the island city. Mont Rigaud, a sanctuary and ski hill, maple country, and a historic village core define this river-and-hill community. About 8,000 people live in Rigaud.
